en.headline: HKMA lifts base rate to 4.25pc, first rise since 2023
en.dek: The monetary authority followed the US Federal Reserve’s quarter-point increase, setting the Discount Window benchmark under the linked exchange rate formula.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Thursday that the Base Rate had been set at 4.25 per cent with immediate effect, tracking a 25-basis-point rise in the US federal funds target range announced on Wednesday, US time.

The Base Rate is the reference used to calculate Discount Window repurchase rates. Under the Authority’s pre-set formula, it is the higher of 50 basis points above the lower end of the prevailing US federal funds target range, or the average of the five-day moving averages of overnight and one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rates.

The HKMA said 50 basis points above the new lower end of the US target range is 4.25 per cent, while the relevant HIBOR average stands at 2.50 per cent, so the formula sets the Base Rate at 4.25 per cent. Reuters and Bloomberg reported it as the first such increase since 2023, when the Federal Reserve and the HKMA last raised rates by a quarter point.

Hong Kong’s monetary operations move in step with US policy because the local dollar is pegged to the greenback. The Authority’s statement did not announce any change to banks’ best lending rates; those remain separate decisions by individual lenders.

zh.headline: 金管局將基本利率調高至4.25厘 2023年以來首次上調
zh.dek: 跟隨美國聯儲局加息四分一厘，金管局按聯繫匯率預設公式即時將貼現窗基準定於4.25厘。
body: 香港金融管理局周四宣布，基本利率根據預設公式定於4.25厘，即時生效，以回應美國於9月16日（美國時間）將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調25個基點。
基本利率是計算經貼現窗進行回購交易時適用貼現率的基礎。按金管局現行公式，基本利率取兩個數字的較高者：美國聯邦基金利率目標區間下限加50個基點，或隔夜及一個月香港銀行同業拆息五天移動平均數的平均值。
金管局表示，目標區間下限加50個基點現為4.25厘，相關拆息平均數則為2.50厘，因此按公式將基本利率定於4.25厘。路透社及彭博報道，這是金管局自2023年以來首次跟隨聯儲局上調基本利率。
由於港元與美元掛鉤，本港貨幣操作與美國政策同步。金管局聲明並未提及銀行最優惠利率；最優惠利率由各銀行自行決定。
